# Identity integration

This page covers initial identity setup for Terraform Enterprise. Ongoing team, role, and SAML management belongs in the [Administration Guide](/validated-designs/terraform/administration-guide/identity-and-access-management).

## SSO and teams

The setup of SSO for HCP Terraform is not covered in detail in this document, as configurations can vary depending on the SAML 2.0-compliant provider used.

- You can find specific instructions for popular identity providers <a href="https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cloud-docs/users-teams-organizations/single-sign-on" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">here</a>.
- For applicable SAML 2.0 documentation, <a href="https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cloud-docs/users-teams-organizations/single-sign-on/saml" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">here</a>.

We recommend automating the creation of teams alongside projects, Stacks, and workspaces using the Terraform Enterprise provider. After creating the initial teams required, automate the addition of users within your strategic IdP platform. By adding a team attribute name (default: MemberOf) attribute within your IdP, you can automatically assign users to the created groups in the SAML configuration. You can find further details <a href="https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/enterprise/saml/configuration" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">here</a>.

Note: For user accounts used by pipelines, use `IsServiceAccount` set to true to flag these in SAML. See <a href="https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/enterprise/saml/attributes#isserviceaccount" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">`isserviceaccount`</a>. Create teams in Terraform Enterprise with the _exact_ name of the group in the IdP. Do not create users manually - Terraform Enterprise creates these automatically after it processes the SAML assertion at login.

We recommend managing site administrator access from your IdP with the boolean `SiteAdmin` SAML attribute (the default Site Admin Attribute Name), assigned only to members of a dedicated administrator group. This keeps privileged access under the same joiner-mover-leaver controls as the rest of your identity estate, and the attribute overrides site admin access granted through `MemberOf`. Terraform Enterprise ignores this attribute when SCIM is enabled. After configuring SAML, log in as a test user from each mapped group and confirm the team memberships and site admin status are correct.
